title: Beam — Share files between phone and computer over Wi‑Fi
description: Send files between your phone and computer over a local Wi‑Fi network. Beam runs on one device; everyone else shares from a browser. No cloud upload or account.
og_description: Local file sharing over Wi‑Fi. The receiver only needs a browser.
h1: Share files over Wi‑Fi. No app for the receiver.
lead: Start Beam on one device. Open its link on the others. Everyone can upload or download from a browser—without an account, cloud upload, or app on the receiving device.
hero_note: Your files stay on your local network.
visual_alt: Illustration of a phone and computer sharing a file over a local Wi‑Fi connection
how_title: From first launch to shared files
how_intro: One device hosts the folder. Other devices join from a browser.
step1_text: Open Beam on the computer that has the files you want to share.
step2_text: Connect devices to the same Wi‑Fi, or start a private Beam network.
step3_text: Scan the QR code or type the link on a phone or computer. No receiver app needed.
download_intro: Choose a platform and build type. Beam recommends the closest match for your device above.
download_iphone_text: You do not need to install Beam on the receiving device. Open the shared link in Safari to upload or download files.
feature_local_text: Files move directly across your local network; Beam does not upload them to a storage service.
feature_receiver_text: Send the link to a phone, tablet, or computer. Recipients do not need an account or Beam installed.
feature_resume_text: Beam sends files in checked chunks and can continue after a connection drop.
feature_open_text: Beam is MIT-licensed. Review the source and release checksums on GitHub.
trust_text: Beam is built for local sharing. Use it on a network you trust, and share only folders you intend others on that network to access.
faq1_q: Do both devices need Beam installed?
faq1_a: No. Install or run Beam only on the device hosting the shared folder. Other devices join using a web browser.
faq2_q: Does Beam need an internet connection?
faq2_a: File transfers work over a local Wi‑Fi network without internet. Internet access is needed to download Beam or check GitHub for a new release.
faq3_a: Choose the file that matches the device running Beam. Most Windows PCs use Windows 64-bit; most Intel or AMD Linux computers use Linux 64-bit; most newer Macs use Apple Silicon.
faq4_q: Are my files uploaded to the cloud?
faq4_a: Beam is designed to transfer files across your local network. It does not use a cloud storage service for transfers.
faq5_q: Can I use Beam on an iPhone?
faq5_a: An iPhone can join from Safari as the receiving device. You do not need to install a separate app to download or upload through the shared link.
footer: Built for sharing on your local network.
proof_one_text: The computer with your shared folder
proof_two_text: No Beam install on other devices
proof_three_text: No cloud storage in the middle
terminal_note: The installer detects your operating system and architecture.
noscript_text: Beam download links and the main product information are available without JavaScript.
checksum_text: Check release files with the published SHA256 checksums.
platform_windows_desc: Choose x64 for most PCs, or ARM64 for ARM-powered devices.
platform_macos_desc: Choose Apple Silicon for M-series Macs, or Intel for older Macs.
platform_linux_desc: Choose a portable build or the package format used by your distribution.
platform_android_desc: Install Beam on the Android device that will host files.
